questions.prompt: The model answers in text, but the last turn ended with reason max-tokens. What exit code does the runner return?
options: 0, because there is an answer to print
1, because only a completed turn returns 0
2, a special code for long answers
No code, because the runner waits for more tokens
questions.explanation: The runner reads the last turn/end reason from the record. Only completed gives 0, so max-tokens gives 1 even though text was printed.

questions.prompt: Why does the runner write reasoning to standard error and not to standard output?
options: Standard output must hold only the final answer, so a script can read it
The model sends reasoning on a different socket
questions.explanation: A script reads standard output as the answer. Keeping the live reasoning on standard error leaves that output clean.

questions.prompt: Why does the runner read events only from firstSeq onward?
options: So an earlier turn in a resumed session cannot give this run its answer or result
Because the model only sees new events
To make the record file smaller
questions.explanation: A resumed session already has events. Only the events this run added describe this task, so an older completed turn cannot make it look successful.
